// diagnostic

E0203

Move marker `^` used on a non-consuming parameter

What

Move marker `^` used on a non-consuming parameter

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0203

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0203: tests/ui/take_on_read_param.stderr.

Error [E0203]: a value was passed with the move marker `^` to a parameter that does not consume
  --> tests/ui/take_on_read_param.jet:7:12
    |
  7 |     greet(^msg)
    |            ^^^
 Why: only parameters declared with the move marker `^` accept a moved value at the call site
 Fix: remove the move marker `^`, or declare the parameter with that marker to take ownership
